title: Who Suffers When There is No Self Q&A
speaker: John Robinson
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating mindfulness, generosity, and non-judgmental awareness in order to overcome defilements like greed, aversion, and delusion. It encourages listeners to experiment with different practices, including meditation, to find what works best for them, and to use these practices as a foundation for further exploration and application in the world. John Robinson also highlights the need for balance and moderation in engaging with life, promoting a sense of boundless goodwill towards all beings while avoiding harm and promoting non-judgmental awareness.
topics: Sutta of the Discourse on the Dhamma
